title: feat(full-core): ratify the sealed today initial-stock candidate as OPTION_D
body:
## Summary
- Ratifies exactly the already sealed system-bound candidate `GOVERNED_TODAY_CANDIDATE_5d6c32292e0cb733` as OPTION_D Today Initial Stock (`RATIFICATION_STATUS=RATIFIED`).
- Does not rewrite the BT pack, does not mint an Initial Stock Anchor, does not mutate `LIVE_EQUITY_STOCK_KIND_SET` (remains `EMPTY_FAIL_CLOSED`), and does not promote venue `eq` to reconstruction source authority (`VENUE_EQ_SOURCE_AUTHORITY=false`; zero GET added; zero POST).
- Fail-closed identity guards deny wrong declaration_id, digest, equity_value, as_of_time, substitution, absent/malformed/fixture candidates.

## Authority bound
- `OWNER_GO_FULL_CORE_LIVE_EQUITY_STOCK_TODAY_INITIAL_STOCK_RATIFICATION_V1`
- `AUTHORIZED_ACTION=TODAY_INITIAL_STOCK_RATIFICATION_ONLY`
- Next required Owner-GO: `OWNER_GO_FULL_CORE_LIVE_EQUITY_STOCK_TODAY_INITIAL_STOCK_ANCHOR_V1`
- Do **not** merge this PR as part of this workpackage.

## Test plan
- [x] `tests/ops/test_full_core_live_equity_stock_today_initial_stock_ratification_wp1.py`
- [x] BT/BS non-regression (`test_full_core_live_equity_stock_today_declaration_governed_binding_contract_wp1.py`, `test_full_core_live_equity_stock_today_initial_stock_source_kind_wp1.py`)
- [x] Atlas validate + impact (`ATLAS_VALIDATE_OK`, `ATLAS_REVIEW_REQUIRED_COUNT=0`)
- [x] Docs token policy + docs reference targets vs `origin/main`
- [x] Selector `PR_BOUNDED_FULL` (`category_central_src_requires_full`) + path-equivalent pytest targets locally green
